channels.label: Position
channels.reason: Labelled body position on a DC channel; a flat trace is typical when the subject stays in one position.

channels.label: DX1
channels.reason: DX (right) on an EMG transducer is the right leg EMG; the ECG-like trace fits cardiac artifact on a leg lead, paired with DX2.

channels.label: DX2
channels.reason: Reference electrode for the right leg EMG pair DX1.

channels.label: MIC
channels.reason: Sound transducer microphone used as the snore channel.

channels.label: C3
channels.reason: Unreferenced C3 electrode with contralateral mastoid A2 recorded separately.

channels.label: C4
channels.reason: Unreferenced C4 electrode with contralateral mastoid A1 recorded separately.

channels.label: ECG1
channels.reason: ECG electrode paired with ECG2; the single-electrode trace may look neural until it is referenced against ECG2.

channels.label: ECG2
channels.reason: Reference electrode for ECG1.

channels.label: A1
channels.reason: Left mastoid reference electrode, used as ref rather than as a target.

channels.label: A2
channels.reason: Right mastoid reference electrode, used as ref rather than as a target.

channels.label: ROC
channels.reason: Right outer canthus EOG on an EOG transducer with a neural-type trace.

channels.label: LOC
channels.reason: Left outer canthus EOG on an EOG transducer; the slow resp-like trace is consistent with slow eye drift.

channels.label: O1
channels.reason: Unreferenced O1 electrode with contralateral mastoid A2 recorded separately.

channels.label: O2
channels.reason: Unreferenced O2 electrode with contralateral mastoid A1 recorded separately.

channels.label: EMG1
channels.reason: Chin EMG electrode paired with EMG2.

channels.label: EMG2
channels.reason: Reference electrode for chin EMG1.

channels.label: Fp2
channels.reason: Fp2 has no canonical target.

channels.label: F4
channels.reason: Unreferenced F4 electrode with contralateral mastoid A1 recorded separately.

channels.label: P4
channels.reason: P4 has no canonical target.

channels.label: FP1
channels.reason: Fp1 has no canonical target.

channels.label: F3
channels.reason: Unreferenced F3 electrode with contralateral mastoid A2 recorded separately.

channels.label: P3
channels.reason: P3 has no canonical target.

channels.label: F8
channels.reason: F8 has no canonical target.

channels.label: T4
channels.reason: T4 has no canonical target.

channels.label: T6
channels.reason: T6 has no canonical target.

channels.label: F7
channels.reason: F7 has no canonical target.

channels.label: T5
channels.reason: T5 has no canonical target.

channels.label: T3
channels.reason: T3 has no canonical target.

channels.label: SX1
channels.reason: SX (left) on an EMG transducer is the left leg EMG; the ECG-like trace fits cardiac artifact on a leg lead, paired with SX2.

channels.label: SX2
channels.reason: Reference electrode for the left leg EMG pair SX1.

channels.label: TORACE
channels.reason: Torace is Italian for thorax, recorded as a respiratory effort belt.

channels.label: ADDOME
channels.reason: Addome is Italian for abdomen, recorded as a respiratory effort belt.

channels.label: STAT
channels.reason: Oximeter status channel that is flat and has no canonical target.

channels.label: HR
channels.reason: Oximeter heart rate in BPM with an HR-type trace.

channels.label: SAO2
channels.reason: Oximeter saturation in % with an SpO2-type trace.

channels.label: PLETH
channels.reason: Oximeter pulse wave with a pleth-type trace.
